name: Rune Dungeon
author: Retro Console
description: A top-down dungeon adventure. Slash slimes, bats and shielded skeletons, find keys, push blocks onto floor plates, shoot crystal switches with your bow and beat two bosses across two dungeons.

achievements.name: Lock Picker
achievements.desc: Open a locked door with a key

achievements.name: Sharpshooter
achievements.desc: Hit an enemy or a crystal with an arrow

achievements.name: Rune Hero
achievements.desc: Defeat the Rune Wraith and restore the rune
